reports.title: New York, November 4, 2026: Flutter Entertainment plc (NYSE: FLUT) (“Flutter”), the world’s leading online sports betting and iGaming operator, today announces Q3 2026 results.

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Early Q4 trading has been in line with expectations on an underlying basis, with unfavorable sports results in both the US and International. Our updated outlook for 2026 now includes the following:
Group: Revenue of $17.61bn (+7% year-over-year) and adjusted EBITDA of $2.495bn, (-12% year-over-year) at the midpoint.

US: The impact of unfavorable sports results in Q3 and Q4 to date16. This results in reductions to revenue and adjusted EBITDA of $60m and $45m, respectively. At the midpoint, US revenue is now $7.34bn (+5% year-over-year) with adjusted EBITDA of $715m (-22% year-over-year). Guidance also reflects an improved outlook for sportsbook performance, and a reduced outlook for iGaming in light of recent trends.

International: The impact of unfavorable sports results in Q3 and Q4 to date16 (-$170m revenue and -$115m adjusted EBITDA), and the previously disclosed impact of the Brazil closure (-$70m revenue and -$20m adjusted EBITDA), which has been offset at an EBITDA level by mitigating cost actions (+$20m adjusted EBITDA).

This results in reductions to revenue and adjusted EBITDA of $240m and $115m respectively. At the midpoint, International revenue is now $10.27bn (+9% year-over-year) with adjusted EBITDA of $2.09bn (-5% year-over-year).
Transaction, restructuring and integration costs17 now approximately $620m, reflecting an increase of $120m since expectations at Q2 2026 primarily due to the increase in legal loss contingencies.
All other guidance items remained unchanged from our last guidance update at Q2:
